title: Buttons and Button Groups
ques: Create a toolbar containing a primary button, an outline secondary button, and a **Button Group (`.btn-group`)** for view modes ('List', 'Grid', 'Map').
explanation: `.btn` and contextual color classes (`.btn-primary`, `.btn-outline-*`) style interactive triggers. `.btn-group` glues adjacent buttons into a seamless single element.

title: Badges and Notification Pills
ques: Demonstrate the use of Bootstrap **Badges (`.badge`)** both as an inline status tag and as a rounded-pill count indicator on a button.

answer.content: Verified Account

explanation: Badges provide compact labels for counts or metadata. Contextual background classes and `.rounded-pill` deliver versatile visual cues.

title: Building Rich Card Components
ques: Construct a full-featured Bootstrap **Card** containing an image cap, card body, title, subtitle, descriptive text, and call-to-action links.

answer.content:
Alpine Mountain Lodge
Switzerland • Resort

Experience pristine mountain vistas, guided ski trails, and luxury spa packages.

explanation: Bootstrap's `.card` component offers a flexible content container with structured sub-classes: `.card-img-top`, `.card-body`, `.card-title`, and `.card-text`.

title: Dismissible Alerts
ques: Create an interactive **Dismissible Alert (`.alert-dismissible`)** with an icon and close button (`.btn-close`).

answer.content: Warning! Your subscription will renew automatically in 48 hours.

explanation: Adding `.alert-dismissible fade show` alongside a `<button class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="alert">` enables smooth JavaScript dismissal of alert banners.

title: Dynamic Progress Bars
ques: Create a striped, animated **Progress Bar** component displaying `70%` completion with a visible percentage label.

answer.content: 70%

explanation: The `.progress` wrapper establishes the progress container, while child `.progress-bar` indicates percentage fill, supporting striped and animated modifiers.
